description:
The display name and cost-attribution tags of a team that API keys belong to.

The document's id is the value API keys carry in `team_id`. The gateway reads the name only to label telemetry, as the `team_name` metric label, and the tags only to attribute requests and to match `tag:` rate-limit policy dimensions; it never uses either for authentication or routing.

name.description: Display name of the team. An empty name is reported as `unknown`.

tags.description: Cost-attribution tags of this team, as tag key to tag value. Each request made with an API key whose `team_id` names this team is attributed to them, per tag key, unless the key itself sets the same key; they take precedence over the owning member's tags. Keys match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`, values are 1 to 128 characters, and at most 32 entries are allowed. Omitted or empty means the team adds no tags.

title: Team
